draft.emotion: optimistic and looking toward the future, gently anticipating a positive outcome
notes: Compound verb formed from आशा (hope, feminine) + करना (to do). In everyday conversation, उम्मीद करना is more common.
Takes की (kī) before a noun or person (किसी से किसी चीज़ की आशा करना), or कि (ki) before a clause.

senses.definition: To want and believe that something good will happen.

examples.text: मैं आशा करता हूँ कि कल बारिश नहीं होगी।
examples.translation: I hope that it will not rain tomorrow.
examples.emotion: sincere and mildly worried about the weather

senses.definition: To look forward to something as likely or due from someone.

examples.translation: We expect good work from you.
